column3: “to be careful with” renders “to separate themselves from,” and “the holy gifts” renders “the holy things” (throughout the chapter).
“a leper” renders “one with tsara’at,” and “a seminal emission” renders “a laying of seed.”
“the offering of the gifts” renders “the contribution of the holy things.”
“Any man” renders “a man, a man,” and “votive” renders “vows.”
“a special vow” renders “to fulfill (pala’) a vow,” and “perfect” renders “unblemished (tamim).”
“having a running sore” renders a rare word (yabbelet) whose meaning is uncertain.
“a lamb” renders “seh,” a sheep or goat.
“a foreigner” renders “a son of foreignness,” and “their corruption” renders “their disfigurement.”
